# flutter_android_volume_keydown — Copilot Instructions

## Overview
Flutter Android plugin for intercepting hardware volume button events. Used by Macadam.CarCheck.

## Tech Stack
- Language: Dart + Java/Kotlin
- Framework: Flutter plugin (Android only)

## Repository Structure
- `lib/` — Dart API
- `android/` — native Android implementation
- `example/` — demo app

## Notes for Copilot
Android-only Flutter plugin. Follow Flutter plugin development conventions.
